prompt: Nissa hires 60 seasonal workers to play elves in her department store's Santa village. 300 children go into the department store to visit at Christmas. A third of the elves quit after children vomit on them, then 10 of the remaining elves quit after kids kick their shins. How many elves are left?

Marcus decided to treat his friends to breakfast. He ordered 5 croissants at $3.00 apiece, 4 cinnamon rolls at $2.50 each, 3 mini quiches for $4.00 apiece, and 13 blueberry muffins that were $1.00 apiece. He also ordered 2 coffees for $5.00 each, but the café made a mistake and didn't charge him for the coffees. At check out, Marcus shows his loyalty card that gives him 10% off of his purchase. What is Marcus' total bill?

Ingrid drinks 8 cups of water every day, even when she goes on her weekly 5-mile run. If there are 16 cups in a gallon, and she maintains this hydration routine regardless of her physical activities, how many gallons of water does she drink in 30 days?

Sally has realized she did not receive a full wage this week. Her bank account, which held $200 at the start of the week, now holds $420. She has received no other money in her bank account this week. If her weekly wage should be $300, including a $50 bonus, how many dollars were withheld from Sally’s wage?

Annika brought $50 to the town fair. She spent half of it on food and snacks, and an additional $10 for rides.  She had her eye on a $50 dress, but she decided not to buy  it beacuse it was too expensive. How much, in dollars, is left?
Parker chews 4 pieces of gum a day.  A pack of gum has 15 pieces of chewing gum per pack, a fifth of which is strawberry flavored.  How many packs of gum will he need to last him 30 days?

Millie decides to open a lemonade stand. She spends $18 to buy enough supplies to make 3 pitchers of lemonade. Each pitcher holds 12 cups of lemonade. Each glass of lemonade contains 500 ml. She sells each cup of lemonade for $1. She sells an average of 4 cups per hour when her lemonade stand is open. If Millie sells all of the lemonade, how much profit will she make per hour that she spends running the lemonade stand?

On Tuesday, Clara bought 20 pomegranates at $20 each. At the till she got $2 off because she had a voucher. Clara then bought ten more oranges at $10 each. The next day, the price shot to $30 per fruit, but the store also offered a 10% discount on the total cost. Sheila took advantage of the discount and bought 20 pomegranates. What is the difference between the final prices paid for the pomegranates on the two days?

A customs officer at the main port of SeaSide clearances counted 2 containers of imported vehicles, each having 5 vehicles inside, three of which were yellow. The next day, more containers were brought in, and the total number of vehicles at the port became 30. Calculate the number of containers that were imported on the second day, assuming all the containers contain 5 vehicles.

Elaina is holding the final concert on her tour. To celebrate her final concert, she makes the concert twice as long as her usual concerts. At the end of the concert, she also performs a 15-minute encore,  singing three songs. If the runtime of this final concert is 65 minutes then how long, in minutes, do her usual concerts run for?

On election day, at 8:00, 5000 people lined up at a polling station to cast their vote. The polling station was located 5 miles away from the city center and the temperature was 25 degrees Celsius. By midday, when the temperature had risen to 30 degrees Celsius but the distance to the city center remained the same, 2/5 of the people had voted. By 16:00, when the temperature had dropped to 28 degrees Celsius and the polling station was still 5 miles away from the city center, 2/3 of the remaining people had voted. What's the number of those who had not voted by 16:00?

A loaf of bread has 24 slices. Abby can eat 2 slices a day while Josh, who is trying to gain weight for a role in a play, can eat twice as much. If Abby and Josh are on a strict diet where they can only eat bread and water, and they have 20 liters of water a day, and it doesn't go down, how many days will the loaf of bread last?
Craig has 2 twenty dollar bills. He buys six squirt guns for $2 each.  He also buys 3 packs of water balloons for $3 each. He has a $3 coupon but finds it expired. How much money does he have left?

Sean is practicing for his role in a theater production for 2 hours a day. He has to memorize his lines for two scenes and the lyrics to one solo song. His solo song has 54 lines in the lyrics. The first scene has twice the number of lines, but only a third of them are his lines. The second scene has six more lines than the song, and four-fifths of them are his. How many lines does Sean have to memorize?

Garrett is popping popcorn for a snack. As the pan of kernels heats up, the kernels start popping faster. Twenty pop in the first 30 seconds of cooking, then three times that amount in the next 30 seconds. The kernels increase to four times the initial popping rate in the next thirty seconds, but in the final 30 seconds, the popping slows down to half the rate as the past 30 seconds. After Garrett takes the pan off the heat, a quarter of the number of kernels that popped in the final 30 seconds of cooking also pop from the residual heat. After all the popcorn pops, Garrett takes 30 seconds to cool it down. How many pieces of popcorn does Garrett have to eat?
If 6 potatoes make 36 hash browns and 3 potatoes make 2 french fries, how many hash browns can you make out of 96 potatoes?

Dale is selling butterscotch candies to raise money for his club at school. He doesn't have the candies yet and is instead just taking orders. He started off with 100 total that he ordered and wanted to sell. However, he ended up selling 150 butterscotch candies, including the ones he found. Then he ordered 100 more candies. In the meantime, he also found another box of 75 candies, but he decided not to sell those and gave them away instead. How many does Dale still need to sell to sell all of his candy?

Jane has been saving $4 of her allowance every week for the past 8 weeks. During this time, she also found a $5 bill on the street and a $1 coin in the couch, but she decided not to include these in her savings. If she continues to save the same amount each week without adding any extra money she finds, how many more weeks will it take for her to have saved a total of $60?

At a party, there were several beverages available: 10 quarts of tea, 5 gallons of lemonade, and 3 gallons of water. However, only the tea was consumed. Four students each drank 1.5 quarts of tea and 16 students each drank 2 quarts of tea. The lemonade and water were untouched. How many gallons of tea were available at the beginning of the party?
James gets 80 emails a day.  20% of those emails don't require any response, including 8 spam emails.  He responds to the rest of them.  How many emails does he respond to in a 5 day work week?
Marty has 100 centimeters of ribbon that he must cut into 4 equal parts. Each cut takes 5 seconds. Each of the cut parts must be divided into 5 equal parts. How long will each final cut be?

Rong has been saving 20 coins worth $1 each in his piggy bank every month. Neil has been saving 2/5 times more coins in his piggy bank per month than Rong. How many coins do they have ten years after they started their savings?

Janey and Sally are in a library. Janey has 3 more than twice the number of books that Sally has. If Janey has 21 books, and there are 50 books on the shelf that neither of them has picked up yet, how many books does Sally have?

A regular box of 100 dishwasher pods costs $12. There's currently a special size box for the same price that has 20% more pods. If you use 1 pod per cycle and each cycle lasts 1 hour, how many dishwashing cycles with the new box can you run for $1, assuming that the duration of the cycle does not affect the number of pods used?

Mary has 30 sheep. Half of them are white and the other half are black. She gets 1 kg of milk from half of them and 2 kg of milk from the other half every day. How much milk does she collect every day?

Sarah went to buy books from the store and spent $300 on the books. She also bought a bookmark for each book at $1 each, but the bookmarks were on a buy-one-get-one-free sale, so she didn't spend any extra money on them. If each book was $15 and she gave an equal number of books to her 4 kids, how many books did each child get?
Ben bought a car for $20000 and a bicycle for $2000 in 2007. The price of the car depreciates at a constant rate of 21% per year. Find the price of the car in the year 2010.
A notebook costs twice as much as a pencil and an eraser combined. A pen costs as much as a pencil and eraser combined. A pencil costs $1.20 and an eraser costs $0.30. How much will 8 pens cost?

Jim has a 20 pack of gum. He chews 1 piece of gum for every 2 hours he's at school over a school day that lasts 8 hours. On his way to school, he sees 5 dogs, 3 cats, and 2 birds, but this doesn't affect his gum chewing habit. He chews 1 piece on the way home from school and 1 stick after dinner, during which he watches a 30-minute TV show and drinks 2 glasses of water. He also gives half the gum he has remaining to his sister when she asks for some right before bed, even though she already has 10 pieces of her own gum. How many pieces of gum does Jim have left at the end of the day?

Adam is excited to ride the biggest roller coaster at the amusement park. The roller coaster has a height requirement of 4 feet. Currently, Adam's height is 40 inches. He grows at a rate of 2 inches per year. Meanwhile, Adam's younger brother, who is not interested in roller coasters, is 36 inches tall and grows at a rate of 3 inches per year. How many years will it take for Adam to be tall enough to ride the roller coaster?
Mark was unwell for 3 months and had injections three times a day, during which he lost 10 pounds per month. If his final weight was 70 pounds, what was his initial weight?

Charlie has boots that are five times the size of Sophie's. Sophie, who just bought a pair of size five boots, and Charlie, who just bought a pair of gloves that cost $20, are wondering about the average size of shoe they wear. What is the average shoe size worn by the two?

In his training as a professional athlete, Tyson runs 5000 meters every day. Tyson runs for 2 hours a day. His coach, however, wants him to run 1/5 times more meters in a day. If he took the coach's advice and trained for a month, what is the total distance he covered in June?

Tom decides to give his wife an anniversary getaway. The plane tickets cost $5000 each. The hotel is 20% more expensive than normal because it is a busy weekend. The normal price is $1500 per day. They also consider renting a car for $200 per day, but eventually decide against it. If they are there for 3 days, taking into account only the plane tickets and the hotel stay, how much did the trip cost?
Adrian's age is three times the age of Harriet, and Harriet is half the age of Zack. Harriet buys a $21000 car. Calculate the average age of the three in three years if Harriet is 21 years old now.

Ram uses a lot of pens. He discovered that he can save money by mixing the ink from five empty pens to make one full pen. If he buys 25 pens and 12 pencils, and then uses them to make new pens when the ink runs low, how many total pens does he get to have?

Stetson made a bet with Alec that he would give up $10 for each orange he eats and $5 for every apple he eats. While at the farm, Stetson ate 2/5 of the oranges they picked. If they picked 60 oranges, calculate the total amount of money Stetson gave up.

Abraham owns 80 square meters of unused land in a town where the average land price is $1 per square meter. He sold half of the land, which was located near a river that is 100 meters wide, for $50. After a month, during which the town's population increased by 500 people, he sold another 1/4 of his land for $30. The remaining land, which is 200 meters away from the town's oldest tree that is 150 years old, he sold for $3 per square meter. How much money will he be able to earn after selling all his unused land?

Darren decides to do body exercises for a whole week. He does 100 pushups, 50 squats, and 20 dumbbell presses on the first day, which takes 3 hours. On the second day, he does 20 more pushups than on the first day, ten fewer squats, and doubles the number of dumbbell presses. What's the total count of the activities he's done in the two days?

Jake is shopping at a clothing store. The store has a buy one get one 50% off deal on T-shirts. Jake buys 2 T-shirts. The original price of each T-shirt is $8. Simultaneously, a customer next to him buys 3 T-shirts at the same price but does not get any discount. Then, Jake buys a pair of shoes that is 40% off the original price. The original price of the shoes is $40. Meanwhile, the same customer buys a pair of shoes at full price. What is the total amount of money Jake spends at the store, ignoring the other customer's purchases?

Vincent is planning a party and wants to buy flowers for decoration. He can buy flowers in packages of 3 for $2.50 or in packages of 2 for $1. He also notices that balloons are sold in packages of 5 for $3.50, but he decides not to buy any balloons. How much money does Vincent save by buying 18 flowers at the better price instead of the more expensive option?

Molly is catering a birthday party for her sister and invited 16 people. 10 people want the chicken salad which is $6.50 per person and 6 people want the pasta salad at $6 per person. Molly also considered ordering a fruit salad for $5 per person, but eventually decided against it. What is the total amount Molly will pay for the catering?

Terry sells 6 milkshakes for $5.50 each, nine burger platters for $11 each, and 20 sodas for $1.50 each. With three milkshakes, two hamburger platters and four sodas left, how much money does he make in total?
Mason likes eating carrots and apples. If he eats 4 carrots and 2 apples each on weekdays and 5 carrots each on Saturday and Sunday, how many carrots does he eat a week?

James is planning a birthday party and wants to hang crepe-paper streamers from his backyard fence. His backyard fence is a rectangle that measures 20 feet on the long side and 15 feet on the short side. He also has a tree in the middle of the yard that is 10 feet tall, but he doesn't want to hang any streamers on the tree. How many feet of crepe paper does James need to buy for his fence?

Howie is planning a special treat for his class and wants to buy cupcakes for everyone. He's unsure if people will prefer vanilla or chocolate cupcakes, so he decides to get one of each for everyone. He also wants to get the same amount of 2 cupcakes for himself and his teacher. However, on his way to the bakery, he spots a sale for cookies. He considers buying 10 cookies for himself, but then decides against it as he prefers cupcakes. If he gets the same amount of 2 cupcakes for each of his 25 classmates, how many cupcakes should Howie buy in total?

Kris is trying to earn a video game achievement for playing a total of 30 hours. She decides to play for half an hour every day for 2 weeks, during which she also spends an additional 15 minutes each day practicing her guitar, which doesn't count towards her video game achievement. After that, she plays for 2 hours every day for a week, while also spending an hour each day on her homework, which also doesn't count towards her video game achievement. How many hours does she still need to play to earn the achievement?

In a kitchen where the ambient temperature is 70 degrees, it takes 20 minutes for the oil to heat up to 300 degrees. The oil then takes 40% longer to heat up to the desired temperature of 400 degrees, even though the stove's heat output is increased by 15%. After warming the oil, it takes 5 minutes less time to cook the chicken than it took to warm up the oil, despite the fact that the chicken was stored at a temperature of 40 degrees. How much time passes from starting to heat the oil to having cooked chicken, considering that the time taken to adjust the stove's heat output and to bring the chicken from the storage is negligible?

Arianna plants a garden that has 10 rows of flowers with 20 flowers in each row. She also plants an additional 5 rows of cacti with 15 cacti in each row, but these cacti do not bloom. Currently, only 4/5 of the planted flowers have bloomed. How many flowers in Arianna's garden have bloomed, not considering the cacti?

John decides to build a program capable of identifying cancer cells. He gets initial funding of $100,000 for the first 5 months of research. During this time, he also receives an additional $50,000 grant for a separate project on AI development, which does not affect his cancer research funding. His cancer research ends up taking 10 times longer than initially planned and every month after those first 5 took 50% more funding per month. Despite receiving a $20,000 donation for a charity run he participated in, this money was not used for his research. How much did his cancer research cost?

Liam and Mitchell own competing lemonade stands across the street from one another. When Liam bragged that he had made $63 selling 21 pieces of bread for $3 each one weekend, Mitchell laughed and told Liam he had sold 21 lemonades at $4 apiece the same weekend. How many more dollars did Mitchell make selling lemonade that weekend than Liam?

Every day, Wendi feeds each of her chickens three cups of mixed chicken feed, containing seeds, mealworms, and vegetables to help keep them healthy.  She gives the chickens their feed in three separate meals. In the morning, she gives her flock of chickens 15 cups of feed and 10 cups of water.  In the afternoon, she gives her chickens another 25 cups of feed.  How many cups of feed does she need to give her chickens in the final meal of the day if the size of Wendi's flock is 20 chickens?

Becky went to a farmer's market where she bought 20 apples for 45 cents each. On her way out, she found a $1 discount coupon on the ground and used it. On the other hand, Kelly went to a grocery store where she bought 20 apples for 50 cents each. She had a loyalty card that gave her a 10 percent discount. Despite the fact that Kelly also bought a bottle of water for $1.50, which is not included in the total cost of the apples, how much more did Kelly pay for her apples than Becky?

Bill is trying to dig a thirty-two foot well in his backyard. He can dig 4 feet/hour through soil and half that fast through clay. If he has to dig through 24 feet of soil and 8 feet of clay, how long will it take him to dig the well?

The glee club, which had 30 members, ordered 20 pizzas for their after-practice party and ate 70% of them. The football team, which had 60 members, ordered twice as many pizzas for their victory celebration and ate 80% of them. Despite the difference in team sizes, how many pizzas are left?

Tom embarked on a two-week-long journey across Europe. In the first 4 days, he traveled 200 kilometers each day, despite the fact that he had to stop every 50 kilometers to refill his water bottle. Over the next two days, he only managed to cover 30% of the distance he traveled in the first four days, even though he had a tailwind of 15 km/h. On the seventh day, he took a break and didn't travel at all, choosing instead to explore a local museum. During the second week, he made 300 kilometers every day, regardless of the fact that he had to change his bike's tire twice. How many kilometers in total did Tom cover during his two-week-long journey?

Last year, Regina wrote 9 novels and also read 15 books that were not her own. If the number of novels she wrote last year is 3 quarters of the number of novels she has written this year, disregarding the number of books she read, how many novels has she written this year?

If every second, a bubbling spring creates a new jellyfish, and each jellyfish has 3 spots on its body, how many jellyfish would 5 springs, each producing jellyfish at the same rate, create in 4 hours, regardless of the number of spots on each jellyfish?

At the Burger Palace restaurant, there is an enormous jar containing red, blue and green jelly beans.  On the outside of the jar is a note that reads, "This jar contains 1% fewer red jelly beans than blue jelly beans and 1% more green jelly beans than blue jelly beans."  If the jar contains a total of 4500 jelly beans, and there are another box with 500 yellow beans that do not affect the number of beans in the jar, how many more green jelly beans does it contain than red jelly beans?

Isabelle bought party supplies for her little sister’s birthday party. She spent $12 on ingredients for the cake, $43 on birthday presents, $15 on decorations, $4 on invitations, and $22 on goodie bags for the party guests. At last, She found out that she had bought a total of 22 goodie bags. She split the cost evenly three ways with her two parents. How many dollars did each person pay?

Andy works in the pro shop of a tennis resort. He has 12 racquets that need restringing. 3 of them are to be strung with synthetic gut, 5 of them will be strung with polyester string, and 4 of them will be strung with a hybrid set (half synthetic gut, half polyester string). Andy also has 7 racquets that are already strung and do not need any work. Additionally, there are 2 cans of tennis balls that he needs to open, but it takes him no time at all. How long will it take Andy to string all of the racquets that need restringing if it takes him an average of 15 minutes for him to string with synthetic gut, 22 minutes to string with polyester string, and 18 minutes for hybrid sets?

A landscaping company is delivering flagstones to a customer’s yard. The company also has to transport 100 pounds of sand for the project. Each flagstone weighs 75 pounds. If the delivery trucks can carry a total weight of 2000 pounds, how many trucks will be needed to transport 80 flagstones in one trip?

Alison qualified for a spot on the running team, so she went shopping for some athletic gear. She bought a tank top for $10, a pair of running shorts for $5 more than the top cost, and a pair of tennis shoes that were originally $48 but were on sale for half price. She had a coupon for $2 off the package of $8 athletic socks that she also bought. On her way to the checkout, she saw a water bottle for $12 and a headband for $3, but she decided not to buy them. She also noticed a sale on protein bars, $1 each or 12 for $10, but she had plenty at home. How much did she spend on athletic gear?
At Dr. Wertz's school, there are twice as many boys as girls. If there are 60 girls, and each girl has 2 pencils, how many teachers are there if there are 5 students to every teacher?

Olivia uploaded 72 pictures to Facebook. She put the same number of the pics into 8 albums. 3 of the albums were selfies only and 2 of the albums were portraits. She also had 5 albums of landscape photos and 4 albums of pet photos, but she didn't upload any of those. How many portraits and selfies did she have?

On Monday, Sue ate 4 times as many cookies as her sister. On Tuesday, she ate twice as many cookies as her sister. Her sister ate 5 cookies on Monday and 13 the next day. In addition, her sister gave 8 cookies to her friend on Monday. If 1 cookie has 200 calories, how many more calories did Sue consume than her sister?

Bud makes homemade macaroni and cheese once a week.  The pasta costs $1.00 a box, and he spends $3.00 on cheddar cheese and twice that amount for the gruyere cheese. He has a $1 coupon but it had expired.  How much money does Bud spend on making macaroni and cheese in one year?

Raphael went to a store to buy some school supplies and a few other items. He bought 4 pens which cost $1.5 each, 2 notebooks which cost $4 each, and a rim of bond paper which cost $20. He also looked at a calculator that cost $15 and a backpack that cost $30, but decided not to buy them. How much did Raphael spend on the school supplies he actually bought?

On her 30th birthday, Elvira decided to treat herself to a new computer setup, complete with accessories. Her generous family had gifted her a budget of €1500 for her birthday. She also had a plan to buy a new outfit with the remaining money. She visited a computer store and picked out a computer that cost €1090, which included a screen, keyboard, and mouse. She also added a scanner priced at €157 to her cart, along with a CD burner worth €74. She spotted a printer for €102 and decided to get that too. On her way to the checkout, she saw a set of speakers for €200 and a gaming chair for €300. However, she decided not to buy them as they were not necessary for her needs. How much money will she have left to spend on her new outfit?

Heather bought a jumbo bag of raisins with 27 cups of raisins in it. She wants to make oatmeal cookies, granola, and a snack mix with the raisins. A batch of oatmeal cookies takes 3/4 of a cup of raisins. She also bought a jumbo bag of raisins to make small cakes, each of which required 2/5 cups of raisins. How many batches of oatmeal cookies can Heather make if she divides the bag of raisins equally among the cookies, granola, and snack mix?

A salesman bought a case of 48 sneakers for $576. On his way to the store, he found a $5 bill on the street, which he used to buy a coffee. He sold 17 of these sneakers for $20 each at a flash sale on Monday, and then he bought a lottery ticket for $2, and won $2. The rest of the sneakers were sold to a department store for $25 each throughout the rest of the week. After all these transactions, how much money, in dollars, was the salesman's profit?

Finn is at a pond observing 11 tadpoles swimming. Suddenly, he notices a dragonfly hovering above the pond, but it quickly flies away without disturbing the tadpoles. Then, he sees 6 more tadpoles emerge from under a lily pad, making him excited. As he continues watching, he sees a leaf floating on the water, but it doesn't affect the tadpoles. Shortly after, he sees 2 of the tadpoles hide under a rock. Despite the dragonfly and the floating leaf, how many tadpoles can Finn see in the pond now?
The expenditure of Joseph in May was $500. And the income of him in May was $1500. In June, his expenditure was $60 less. How much was his total expenditure for those two months?

Meredith is a freelance blogger who writes about health topics and submits to clients each day as her permanent job. She also has a hobby of painting, but this doesn't interfere with her writing schedule. A blog article takes an average of 4 hours to research and write about. Last week, she wrote 5 articles on Monday and 2/5 times more articles on Tuesday than on Monday. On Wednesday, she wrote twice the number of articles she wrote on Tuesday. Despite spending 3 hours painting a landscape on Tuesday and 2 hours on a portrait on Wednesday, these activities didn't affect her writing time. Calculate the total number of hours she spent writing articles in the three days.

Gary likes to walk around the edge of the local park, which is a rectangle that measures 1.5 miles by 6 miles. He is used to doing five minutes of stretching before a walk. If he walks at 3 miles/hour, how many hours does he spend walking?

The school auditorium has 4 rows of seats, with 18 seats in each row. One-fourth of the seats were occupied by the administrators. In the midst of the event, a group of 20 alumni arrived but decided to stand at the back instead of sitting. One-third of the remaining seats after the administrators took their seats were occupied by the parents. The rest of the seats were filled by the students. How many students were there in the school auditorium?

John visits his parents twice a month. Each time he visits his parents, he stays at their home for two days.  It takes him 2 hours to drive there at a speed of 70 mph.  Considering the round trip, how many miles a month does he drive when visiting his parents?

A pound of almonds costs $10, and a pound of walnuts costs $15. A squirrel has gathered 1/2 pound of almonds and 1/3 pound of walnuts, while a chipmunk has gathered 1/5 pound of almonds and 1/3 pound of walnuts. If a bird comes along and adds 2 ounces of sunflower seeds to each of their collections, which doesn't change the cost of the nuts, how much more does it cost for the squirrel's mixture of nuts than the chipmunk's mixture?

Martha is knitting winter wear for her 3 grandchildren. They're triplets, so they're all the same size. She wants to make a hat, scarf, sweater, mittens, and socks for each of them. It takes 2 skeins of wool to make a hat, 4 for a scarf, 12 for a sweater, 1 for a pair of mittens, and 2 for a pair of socks. Martha also has a cat that loves to play with the wool. The cat uses 5 skeins of wool per day to play, but Martha always takes them back at the end of the day, so they don't affect the total amount of wool she needs. How many skeins of wool will Martha need to buy?

Tim works in a company that has a unique policy of giving its employees a 5% raise on their monthly salary every time they get a promotion. Tim, who has a monthly salary of $20000, just got promoted. The promotion also comes with a bonus worth half a month's salary. However, the company also has a policy of deducting $100 from the bonus for every year the employee has worked at the company. Tim has been working at the company for 10 years. Despite this, the company has decided to waive this policy for Tim's bonus this time. How much money will Tim make in a year?

Carly had 80 cards. She divided them into different categories. 2/5 of the cards had the letter A on them. She then found a box of 20 old cards in her attic, but decided not to include them in her current collection. 1/2 of the remaining cards from her original collection had the letter B, and 5/8 of the rest had the letter C on them. She also found a set of 15 stickers, but she didn't stick them on any of the cards. The remaining cards from her original collection had the letter D on them. How many of the cards had the letter D on them?

To raise money for their class fund, each of the 30 students from one class sold lollipops that cost $0.8 per lollypop and cookies that cost $0.5 per cookie. On average, each student sold 10 lollipops. If they bought the lollipops for $0.5 each, how much money was the class able to raise from the profit of selling lollipops?

Ali has four $10 bills and six $20 bills that he saved after working for Mr. James on his farm. Ali gives her sister half of the total money he has and uses 3/5 of the remaining amount of money to buy dinner. Ali's sister gives half of the money she receives to his mother. Calculate the amount of money he has after buying the dinner.

Ryan’s allowance is $6 each week he completes his chores. He did his chores for 3 weeks. During this time, he also found a $5 bill on the street, but he decided to donate it to a local charity. Then he bought ice cream cones for himself and 3 friends at $1.25 each. They all enjoyed the ice cream so much that they wanted to buy another round, but the ice cream shop had unfortunately run out of cones. Now they all want to go to the movies and tickets cost $6.50 each. How many movie tickets can Ryan buy?

Gabriel is planning to buy a car and a phone. The car costs $10000 and the phone costs $800. He has saved $5000 from working on weekends at a local cafe where he earns $200 per weekend. His brother, who recently won $500 in a lottery but decided to only give Gabriel $200 to help him out, also contributed to his savings. Considering all these factors, how much more money does Gabriel need to buy the car and the phone?

Mariah’s grandma was teaching her to knit. Mariah used 1/4 of a skein of yarn. Her grandma used 1/2 of a skein of yarn. There are 364 yards in a skein of yarn. A skein of yarn costs $35. How many yards of yarn did they use altogether?
In 10 years, Melanie will be 18 years old. Melanie also has a 3-year-old dog. In how many years will her age be thrice her present age?

Lauren is a cartoonist who also enjoys painting in her free time. She can draw 5 large-sized picture scenes per day, or she can draw 6 medium-sized picture scenes per day, or she can draw 7 small-sized picture scenes per day. In her free time, she paints 2 canvases per day, but this doesn't affect her drawing speed. She was hired for a big project to create 45 large-sized picture scenes, 36 medium-sized picture scenes, and 49 small-sized picture scenes. She also plans to paint 20 canvases during this period, but this won't interfere with her project. How many days will it take for her to create all of the picture scenes for the project?

Paul is planning a birthday party on Saturday and needs 63 cupcakes in total. He already has 8 chocolate cupcakes and 40 toffee cupcakes. He also has 15 red velvet cupcakes, but he decided not to serve them at the party because some guests don't like red velvet. How many more cupcakes should Paul buy for the party?

Every day, Charisma wakes up at 6:30 am and meditates for 15 minutes. She then goes about her day, which includes a 30-minute breakfast at 7:00 am, a 45-minute commute to work at 8:00 am, and an 8-hour workday that starts at 9:00 am. Before she goes to sleep at 10:30 pm, she meditates again for 15 minutes. Five days a week, she also practices 1 hour of yoga, which she does right after her work ends at 5:00 pm, before her 1-hour dinner at 6:30 pm. In 4 weeks, disregarding the time she spends on breakfast, work, commute, and dinner, how much time has she spent on meditation/yoga practice?

Jessica is trying to figure out how much to pay on all her debts each month. Her student loans have a minimum payment of $300/month, her credit card's minimum is $200/month, and her mortgage's minimum is $500/month. She also subscribes to Netflix for $15 a month, but she has a coupon to offset that $15. If Jessica wants to pay 50% more than the minimum on her debts and continues to pay the regular amount for her gym and Netflix, how much does she pay for her debts in a year?

Britany records 18 4-minute TikTok videos each week. She spends 2 hours a week writing amateur songs to sing on TikTok, and 15 minutes six days a week doing her makeup before filming herself for TikTok. In addition, she spends 30 minutes a week going to the dance club to practice dancing. How much time does Britany spend on TikTok in a month with four weeks?
Grace weighs 125 pounds and is 168 centimeters tall. Alex weighs 2 pounds less than 4 times what Grace weighs. What are their combined weights in pounds?

During her science class study, Brady discovered that each whale in the sea has 40 gallons of blood. She also found out that a shark has three times as much blood as a whale. In the same class, she learned that a dolphin has half the blood volume of a whale, but this information is not relevant to her current calculations. Brady is now curious to find out the total number of gallons of blood that ten sharks swimming in the sea would have. Can you help her with this calculation?

On a day when the wind speed in Southlandia was 15 mph, the highest temperature ever recorded there was -48 degrees Fahrenheit. Meanwhile, in Northlandia, where the humidity level was 80%, the highest temperature ever recorded was 21 degrees Fahrenheit. Over in Midlandia, despite a rainfall of 2 inches, the highest temperature recorded was -3 degrees Fahrenheit. What is the average highest temperature of these 3 countries, regardless of the weather conditions?

There is one set of twins and one set of triplets. One twin is 7 years older than one triplet. The family also has a pet dog that is 5 years old and a pet cat that is 3 years old. If their combined ages of twins and triplets are 44, how old is one of the twins?

Jamaal is at the gym. He has been using an 8-pound weight. He wants to lose 15 pounds. He increases the weight that he uses by 50%. It turns out to be too heavy, so he uses a weight two pounds lighter than that. What is the weight, in pounds, that he now uses?

John embarks on a journey driving for 3 hours at a speed of 60 mph. He then realizes he left his lucky charm at home and decides to turn around. On his way back, he gets caught in a parade that lasts for 2 hours, during which he can't move at all. After the parade, he drives for the next half-hour at a speed of 30mph, while listening to a podcast that is 45 minutes long. Then, he manages to drive the remaining time of the 4 hours going at 80 mph, while the temperature outside fluctuates between 60 and 80 degrees Fahrenheit. How far is he from home at the end of those 4 hours?

A shop sells school supplies and also offers a variety of snacks. One notebook is sold at $1.50 each, a pen at $0.25 each, a calculator at $12 each, a geometry set at $10, a bag of chips at $1.00 each, and a soda at $1.50 each. Daniel is an engineering student, and he wants to buy five notebooks, two pens, one calculator, and one geometry set. He also feels like having a snack, but decides to eat at home instead. The shop gives a 10% discount on all the purchased items. How much does Daniel have to spend on all the items he wants to buy?

Greta’s paycheck is $2400.00. She puts 50% of her pay into her retirement account. She then uses 20% of her paycheck to make her monthly car payment. After funding her retirement and paying for her car, she decides to put 10% of her remaining money into a savings account for a vacation she plans to take next year. However, she changes her mind and decides not to put any money into the vacation account this month. After all these considerations, how much money does she have left to spend?

Richard lives in an apartment building with 15 floors. The building is 50 meters high. Each floor contains 8 units, and 3/4 of the building is occupied. What's the total number of unoccupied units In the building?

While at the dollar store, Sloane counts 100 customers entering the store. The next day, she counts 50 more customers than the first day. On the third day, she notices that for every 2 customers entering, 1 customer leaves the store, but she only counts those entering. If the total number of customers entering the store by the end of the third day was 500, how many customers did she count entering on the third day?

According to its nutritional info, a bag of chips has 250 calories per serving. This bag of chips also contains 10g of fat per serving, but this doesn't affect the calorie count. If a 300g bag has 5 servings and each serving also contains 2g of fiber, how many grams can you eat if your daily calorie target is 2000, you have already consumed 1800 calories, and you've reached your daily fiber intake?

Ray had 25 lollipops. He decided to keep 5 lollipops for himself and 2 lollipops as a reserve for later，but he did not save 2 lollipops as a reserve for later at last. After setting aside the 5 lollipops, which he didn't share, he distributed the remaining lollipops equally among his four friends. How many lollipops did each of his friends receive?

Jen decides to travel to 3 different countries.  He has to pay $400 for the supplies he needs, in total.  The tickets for travel cost, in total, 50% more than the supplies. He also plans to buy a few souvenirs worth $50 but eventually gives up due to a limited budget. How much does travel cost?

Calvin is preparing soup for his family for dinner. He has a pot with enough soup to fill four adult's bowls or eight child's bowls. He is an adult and will be eating with his adult wife and their two children. Calvin's brother, who is also an adult, unexpectedly shows up for dinner but he just ate and won't be having any soup. If everyone eats one bowl at a meal, how many times will each child be able to have a bowl of soup for lunch from the leftover soup?

Josey had 15 gallons of gas that she equally divided into 5 different containers. Each container was then placed in a separate room with temperatures varying from 60 to 80 degrees Fahrenheit. Despite the temperature differences, the volume of the gas remained constant. Josey needed 1/4 of a container to run her lawnmower. How many pints of gasoline did Josey need?
If Ann is 9 years old, her brother is twice her age and her sister is 3 years younger than her, how old will her brother be in 3 years?

John decides to take a cooking class.  The class meets 4 times a week for 2 hours each time for 6 weeks. Additionally, after each cooking class, he takes a 5-minute break to rest his hands.  If he learns a new recipe for every 1.5 hours of class time, how many recipes does he learn?

Madeline was at a picnic and ate 6 grapes. Her brother, who was trying to stay hydrated, decided to make grape juice and used up 5 times as many grapes as Madeline to make a full glass. Their mother, who was preparing for a bake sale, then used the remaining grapes to make 4 pies. Their mother wants to sell each pie for $3.  If each pie recipe calls for 12 grapes and the grape juice didn't affect the taste of the pies, how many grapes were there at the beginning?

Janet takes two bus trips five days a week to get to her job at the city library. On each trip, she passes by 3 coffee shops, 2 parks, and 4 tall buildings, but these sights don't affect her bus fare. If each bus trip costs her $2.20, despite the number of coffee shops, parks, or buildings she passes, how much would she save by buying a weekly bus pass for $20?

The ratio of popsicles that Betty and Sam have is 5:6. If the total number of popsicles they have together is 165, and 56 of them are animal-shaped, how many more popsicles does Sam have more than Betty?

Mike's teacher assigns a 200-page book as homework, which needs to be completed within 30 days. Mike decides to read 10 pages a day. However, his friend John, who reads at a different pace, plans to read 15 pages a day. Despite this, John's reading plan does not affect Mike's schedule. How many days before the deadline will Mike finish his reading?

Milo is making a mosaic with chips of glass. It takes twelve glass chips to make every square inch of the mosaic. A bag of glass chips holds 72 chips. Milo wants his mosaic to be three inches tall. He also has a box of 50 unused chips from a previous project, but he decides not to use them for this mosaic. If he has two bags of glass chips, how many inches long can he make his mosaic?

Marcell and Beatrice are having a contest to see who can eat the most fruit roll-ups, so they unroll as many as they can find. Unfortunately, someone makes a mistake and Beatrice's was two roll-ups wide and 24 rolls up long while Marcell's was 3 roll-ups wide and 14 roll-ups long. The whole contest lasted two and a half hours. If they both ate their entire amount, how many did they eat on average?
Martha has been collecting shells since she turned 5 years old, every month she collects one shell and 2 pearls. By her 10th birthday, how many shells will Martha have collected?

Mr. Hezekiah had 20 trucks from his store supplying fertiliser to different farmers in his hometown dispatched for delivery on a particular day. Each truck was carrying 20 tons of fertiliser packed in bags. Two hours after the trucks had departed for delivery, Mr Hezekiah got the news that a quarter of the number of lorries dispatched for delivery had mechanical failures on the road and could not deliver the fertilisers to the farmers. At the same time, he also received a report that 5 of his trucks had been caught in a heavy rainstorm, but luckily the waterproof covers on the trucks protected the fertiliser from getting wet and did not affect the delivery. Calculate the total number of tons of fertiliser that reached the farmers that day?

Ali is a dean of a private school where he teaches one class. John is also a dean of a public school with a library for 200 students. John has two classes in his school. Each class has 1/8 the capacity of Ali’s class which has the capacity of 120 students. What is the combined capacity of both schools?

James has 30 teeth. His dentist drills 4 of them. At the same time, a dental hygienist cleans 10 teeth, but this doesn't affect the number of teeth the dentist fixes. The dentist then caps 7 more teeth than he drills. What percentage of James' teeth does the dentist fix?

John is on a diet where he eats 200 grams of mushrooms every day, which are known to weigh 100 grams per cup and contain 3 grams of protein. He also drinks 2 liters of water daily and walks 5 kilometers every morning. Given this, how many grams of protein does John consume from the mushrooms in a week?

Four children are playing together—Akbar, Alessandro, Helene, and Wilfred. Helene is twice as old as the average age of the group, and the total age of the children is 20. Each child has a 2-year-old puppy. If Akbar is 3 years old and Alessandro is 4 years old, calculate the age of Wilfred.

If Marcy works for the same company for 40 years, she gets an annual pension of $50,000/year. Marcy earns $3,000 per month. Starting after 20 years, she becomes entitled to 5% of the value of the pension per year. If she quits after 30 years, what will her annual pension be?

Arnold, Madeline, Camden, Sarah, and their friend, Benjamin, decided to have a fun day painting easter eggs. They painted a total of 56 easter eggs. Arnold and Madeline painted the same number of eggs, while Benjamin, who was more interested in eating the chocolate eggs, didn't paint any but painted 3 walls. Camden and Sarah, who were competing to see who could paint the most, painted a total of 30 eggs. In their friendly competition, Camden managed to paint 12 more eggs than Sarah. How many more eggs did Camden paint than Arnold?

Maddy is buying pizza for her cousin's soccer game. There are 12 team members and 3 coaches. Each team member brings 2 guests. A pizza, which has 12 slices, will serve 3 people. If each pizza costs $15, how many dollars will Maddy spend?

While Joanne is gathering apples from her family’s orchard, her sister comes outside to help her. Joanne gathers 30 apples from the tallest trees, half this amount from the shortest trees, and more apples from the average trees. In addition, Joanne gathers 20 oranges from the tallest, shortest, and average trees. Compared with Joanne, her sister gathers twice as many apples from the tallest trees and 3 times as many apples from the shortest trees. She doesn't take any from the average trees. If the sisters have gathered a combined total of 500 apples, how many apples did Joanne gather from the average trees?

The light on a lighthouse blinks 255 times in 5 minutes. On a particular day, a flock of 30 birds flew past the lighthouse every 10 minutes, and a ship sailed by every 15 minutes. Despite these distractions, the blinking of the light was not affected. How long will it take the light to blink 459 times?

Carly is making cupcakes and brownies for her art class. She also decides to make 50 cookies but realizes that she doesn't have enough ingredients. She makes 2 less than three times as many brownies as cupcakes. If Carly's class has five people and each person gets two treats, how many cupcakes did Carly make?

John likes to have a glass of water and a glass of milk for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.  Finally, he has one before he goes to bed as well.  John does this every weekday, but on the weekends he likes to relax and have a soda with dinner instead.  How many glasses of water does John drink in a week?

Farmer Brown has 20 animals on his farm, all either chickens or cows. They have a total of 70 legs, all together. Farmer Brown also has 5 scarecrows scattered around his farm, each with 2 legs, and 3 tractors, each with 4 wheels. Ignoring the scarecrows and tractors, how many of the animals are chickens?
Mulan has $40. Her father gave her $100. She buys two pairs of jeans at $30 each and a bag for $20. She also tried on a $20 dress at the mall. How much money does Mulan have left?

Jill and her friends watch 4 movies every Saturday and half the number of movies on Sunday than on Saturday. In addition, they watch two episodes of the TV series every Sunday If they watch movies every weekend, how many movies can they watch in 4 weeks?

A new program had 60 downloads in the first month. In the second month, despite a server outage that lasted 2 hours and a temporary price increase of $1.99, the number of downloads was three times as many as the downloads in the first month. However, in the third month, even though the program was featured in a popular tech blog and the price was reduced by 50%, the number of downloads reduced by 30%. How many downloads did the program have total over the three months?

Jerry has a flock of chickens on his farm, which is 100 acres large. The red chickens, which weigh an average of 2 pounds each, produce 3 eggs a day, and the white chickens, which weigh an average of 2.5 pounds each, produce 5 eggs a day. Every day, after walking 2 miles around his farm, Jerry collects 42 eggs. If he has two more white chickens than red chickens, and each chicken eats 0.2 pounds of feed per day, how many red chickens does he have?

Harold sleeps for 10 hours a night.  He works 2 hours less than he sleeps and he walks his dog for an hour each day, 20 minutes of which is spent playing frisbee with the dog.  How much free time does Harold have left in his day?

Melissa is summoned to jury duty during a week when the city is conducting a survey on parking costs. She spends 6 hours a day for 3 days listening to a court case. The city survey reveals that the average parking cost in the city is $5, but Melissa only has to pay $3 for parking each day at the courthouse. If Melissa is paid $15 per day for jury duty, how much does she make per hour after her parking expenses are deducted?

James is a shoe enthusiast who buys 2 pairs of shoes every month. He also has a habit of buying a $5 coffee each time he goes shoe shopping, which he does twice a month. Despite his coffee expenses, he still manages to spend $2640 on shoes alone each year. How much does he pay on average for each pair of shoes?

When Billy was first hired, he was paid at a rate of $10 per hour and works 8 hours a day.  After 2 months, he was given a raise of $0.50 per hour.  On his first anniversary at work, he was given a raise of $1.00 per hour.  Sally just started working at a different business, and her starting salary is $0.50 more per hour than Billy's starting salary was.  If both Billy and Sally work 20 hours, how much more money will Billy earn than Sally, in dollars?
Of the 20 available cars for rent, 12 are automatic cars, 4 are manual cars, and the rest are semi-automatic. Each car rental is $500 per day. What percentage of the cars are semi-automatic?

Kelian is preparing for a dinner party and has two recipes to follow. The first recipe is for a salad and has 20 instructions. The second recipe is for a main dish and is more complex, having twice as many instructions as the salad recipe. During his preparation, Kelian also has a dessert recipe with 15 instructions. How many instructions does Kelian have to read to prepare the salad and the main dish for his dinner party?

It takes John 5 minutes to get to the first side of the Rubik's cube, including 2 minutes of thinking time.  The second and third sides each take twice that long.  The last 2 sides each take half as long as the first, and once you get the 5th side you have all 6 sides.  How long does the Rubik's cube take?

Terri is knitting a sweater with two sleeves, a collar, and a decorative rosette. She also wants to knit a 450-stitch hat as a present for her mom. The body of the sweater takes 900 stitches to complete, the collar takes a tenth of that number of stitches, and the rosette takes twice as many as the collar. The whole sweater is an 1800-stitch project. How many stitches does each sleeve take?

In the teacher's lounge, there are some coffee mugs and 40 tea cups. Eight more than four times the number of coffee mugs equals 40. If the number of tea cups is irrelevant and does not affect the total, how many coffee mugs are in the teacher's lounge?

Manny signed up for Karate classes for $60. His parents tell him that if his classes end up costing more than $10 per class, then they won't sign him up again. Manny also signed up for a painting class that costs $30, but his parents don't care about the cost of this class. If there are 10 total Karate classes, how many Karate classes can he miss before they don't sign him up again?

John has 10 hectares of a pineapple field, and each hectare can produce 100 pineapples. He also has a mango field of 5 hectares, but the mangoes are not ready for harvest yet. John can harvest his pineapples every 3 months, while the mangoes take 6 months to mature. Ignoring the mango field, how many pineapples can John harvest from his pineapple field within a year?

A toy manufacturer receives an order for 400 toys. 5 workers are available to work on the order. 2 of the workers produce 6 toys an hour, and another 2 workers produce 4 toys an hour. They all work on the order during their 10-hour shift. Simultaneously, a shipment of 1000 toy parts arrives at the factory, but this does not affect the current order. By the end of their shift, despite the distraction of the incoming shipment, the manufacturer still needs another 20 toys to be able to ship the order. How many toys per hour does the fifth worker produce?

Jack decides to visit a museum 150 miles from home. On his way, he passes through a town 50 miles from home where he spots a rare bird but doesn't stop. He continues driving at 75 mph until he reaches the museum. After spending 6 hours at the museum, he drives back home at the same speed, passing through the same town without stopping. How long is he gone from home?

Jam has three boxes full of pencils and 2 loose pencils which give a total of 26 pencils. If her sister, Meg, has 46 pencils and 5 erasers, how many boxes do Jam and Meg need to store all their pencils?

Katherine is planning a garden party and wants to decorate her backyard with 5 hanging baskets. She decides to fill each basket with 3 petunias and 2 sweet potato vines. The petunias cost $3.00 apiece and the sweet potato vines cost $2.50 apiece. She also considers adding roses to the baskets, which cost $4.00 each, but eventually decides against it. How much will she spend filling all 5 hanging baskets with only petunias and sweet potato vines?

John packs M&M in small bags to eat.  He buys 3 large bags weighing 10 ounces each. On his way home, he stops by a park where five kids are playing, and each has a small bag of M&M. An ounce of M&M has 30 M&M in it. How many small bags can he make if he puts 10 in each small bag?

During a rainstorm, the wetlands were flooded and Phineas Frog was washed 200 yards away from his home in the swamp. To return home, he will need to hop and swim his way back. If he hops on land at a speed of 20 yards per minute, and swims through water at a speed of 10 yards per minute, how long will it take Phineas, in minutes, to return home if half of the distance is on land and the other half is in water? Along the way, he spots a delicious fly 50 yards off his path. If he decides to catch the fly, it would take him an extra 5 minutes, but he decides to stay focused on his journey home.

Randy has 9 oatmeal cookies, 4 chocolate chip cookies, and 5 sugar cookies. He ate 3 cookies for an early day snack, one of each flavor. He ate 2 oatmeal cookies and 2 apples for lunch. He gives 2 sugar cookies to his friends. Then, he bakes 4 of each flavor for dinner. How many cookies does he have now?

At a restaurant, Juice Box A is 4 dollars. Juice Box B is 5 dollars more than Juice Box A. Juice Box C is 7 dollars more than Juice Box A. Juice Box D is 3 dollars. How much more is Juice box C than Juice Box B?

Janet gets a job as a waitress.  She makes $10 an hour from wages and another $15 an hour from tips.  She wants to save up to 20% of the cost of a $10000 car for a downpayment. She also wants to save $1,000 to buy a mobile phone but gives up due to too much pressure. If she works 40 hours a week how many weeks will she need to work to save the down payment?

A customer’s loyalty card at a store gives them rewards of $1 off their next purchase for every $20 they spend. Their last shopping trip, they spent $80. This shopping trip, they spent $43, used their rewards, and applied a coupon that took twice the amount of rewards off the price. They also decided to spend $120 on next trip. How many dollars did the customer pay on this shopping trip?
Out of the 200 Grade 5 students, 2/5 are boys and 2/3 of the girls are in the girl scout. Among the boys, 3/10 do well in the exams. How many girls are not in the girl scout?

The marching band is ordering 40 new uniforms. Each uniform comes with a hat that costs $25, a jacket that costs three times as much as the hat, and pants that cost the average of the costs of the hat and jacket. How much does each uniform cost in total?

Bill is signing up for a new streaming service. He got a special introductory deal where the first 6 months were $8 a month, then it went up to the normal price of $12 a month. After 8 months of the normal rate, the service increased its price to $14 a month. During this time, Bill also subscribed to a magazine that cost him $5 a month, but he cancelled it after 2 months. He also bought a new TV for $500, but he sold it after a year for the same price. How much do 2 years of the streaming service cost him?

Mr. Smith has two farms, Farm X and Farm Y. He has 55 goats in Farm X and 45 goats in Farm Y. He also has 30 chickens on Farm X and 20 chickens on Farm Y, but these chickens are not for sale. One day, he sold 10 goats from Farm X and twice as many goats from Farm Y. Despite the sale of goats, the number of chickens remained the same. How many goats are left in the two farms altogether?

Jillian went shopping and bought a handbag and a pair of shoes. She also bought a scarf for $30, but she used a gift card to pay for it, so it didn't affect the total amount she spent. The handbag cost $20 less than 3 times as much as her shoes cost. If her shoes cost $80, how much did her bag cost?

Aaron and Vanessa were relay race partners on a running team. Aaron was able to run each mile twice as fast as Vanessa, but Vanessa was able to run twice as far as Aaron did. In addition, the running team had a substitute Mike, who was able to run 1.5 times faster than Vanessa per mile. If Vanessa ran 4 miles and Aaron completed his part of the race in 16 minutes, how long in minutes did Vanessa take to complete her part?

Timothy's locker is 24 cubic inches and he has a small box that takes up 2 cubic inches of space, leaving him with 22 cubic inches of usable space. Zack's locker is half as big as Timothy's locker, but he doesn't have a box in his locker. Peter's locker is 1/4 as big as Zack's locker, and he also doesn't have a box in his locker. How big is Peter's locker in cubic inches?

Jen works at a bustling coffee shop for 7.5 hours a day, 6 days a week. Her hourly rate is $1.5. Every day, she serves an average of 100 customers, each buying a coffee for $3.50. However, the cost of coffee and the number of customers she serves do not affect her earnings. If Jen has complete attendance for the month, she receives an additional $10. In April, a month with exactly 4 weeks, Jen did not miss a single day of work. How much will she receive for her work in April?

Hannah's city is having a big display of fireworks for the 4th of July. They're going to set off 15 boxes of 20 fireworks each. Hannah's house is at the right angle to see 40% of the city's fireworks. Hannah will also set off 3 boxes of 5 fireworks each in her backyard. Meanwhile, her neighbor, John, is setting off 2 boxes of 10 fireworks each, but his house is obstructed by a large tree, so Hannah can't see any of his fireworks. Additionally, the city park is setting off 50 fireworks, but it's too far away for Hannah to see. How many fireworks will Hannah see in total?

James is in charge of running messages from the office to each teacher's classroom, and it takes him three minutes to deliver each message. If he delivers 66 messages to Ms. Thompson and 1/3 as many messages to Mr. Yu, how many messages does he deliver in total?

Cindy's math and science books weigh 2 pounds each. She also has a geography book that weighs 5 pounds, but she leaves it at school. Her French book weighs 4 pounds and her English book weighs 3 pounds. Her history book weighs twice as much as her English book, but she also has a Spanish book that weighs 1 pound, which she doesn't need to carry. If Cindy carries all of her books except the geography and Spanish books, what will be the total weight of the books she is carrying?

Jared is trying to increase his typing speed. He has a 500-word vocabulary bank. He starts with 47 words per minute (WPM). After some lessons the next time he tests his typing speed it has increased to 52 WPM. If he continues to increase his typing speed once more by 5 words, what will be the average of the three measurements?

Mary has 6 jars of sprinkles and 8 jars of cream in her pantry. Each jar of sprinkles can decorate 8 cupcakes. Mary wants to bake enough cupcakes to use up all of her sprinkles. If each pan holds 12 cupcakes, how many pans worth of cupcakes should she bake?
Mr. Ruther sold 3/5 of his land and had 12.8 hectares left. He made fifty thousand dollars by selling land. How much land did he have at first?

A company produces chocolate in bars. In one day, it can produce 5000 bars. The company also produces 2000 chocolate candies for $4 each. The company sells all the produced bars for $2 per bar. How much money will the company receive for selling produced chocolate bars in two weeks?

A Tyrannosaurus rex ate half of a small triceratops it had hunted. When it left, a pack of velociraptors, who had been hiding 30 meters away, scavenged half of what was left. A group of lazy Allosaurus gulped down the last 270 kilograms of meat. How many kilograms of meat were on the triceratops before the T-Rex ate?

John is very tired. He decides to take a nap, but he wants to finish his homework first. If John has 20 minutes of math homework, 40 minutes of reading homework, and 20 minutes of history homework and 3 hours before he has to eat dinner, after dinner, John wants to play 30 minutes of games, how many minutes does John have to nap?
Siobhan has 2 fewer jewels than Aaron. Aaron has 5 more jewels than half of Raymond's jewels. If Raymond has 40 jewels, 17 of which are pink, how many jewels does Siobhan have?

A bakery produces 60 loaves of bread each day. Each loaf of bread sells for $5. Two-thirds of the loaves are sold in the morning and half of what is left is sold equally in the afternoon and evening. How many loaves of bread are sold in the afternoon?

Ashley is hosting a pizza party and orders a pizza delivery that costs $15. She also orders a 2-liter soda that costs $5, but she has a coupon that makes the soda free. If she wants to give a tip to the delivery man that is equal to 1/5 of the amount she ordered for the pizza, how much should she give the delivery man in total?
Jan has three times the number of pets as Marcia. Marcia has two more pets than Cindy. If Cindy has four pets and she buys a toy for each pet, how many total pets do the three have?

Julie, Micah, and Mitchell sold 32 glasses of lemonade at their lemonade stand. They also sold 18 glasses of iced tea. Julie sold 14 glasses and the boys sold an equal number of glasses. How many more glasses did Julie sell than Micah?

Tobias bought a big pizza with 60 pieces for $50. He ate 2/5 of the pieces on the first day, 10 pieces on the second day, and 7/13 of the remaining pieces on the third day. How many pizza pieces has he eaten so far?

Ella earned $33 for 3 hours of dog walking. During this time, she also found 5 lost tennis balls and saw 7 different bird species, but these didn't affect her earnings. If she continues to walk dogs at the same rate, while possibly finding more tennis balls and seeing more birds, how much would she earn after 12 hours?

The Adams family is busy making cookies for a big event. Amidst the hustle and bustle, they've managed to bake 7995 cookies in total. Out of these, 2595 are rainbow cookies, 3075 are oatmeal cookies, and the rest are chocolate chip cookies. In the midst of all this, they also baked 500 sugar cookies for a separate order, but these are not included in the total count. How many chocolate chip cookies have they made?

Out of the 150 teachers on the school basketball court, 60% are history teachers and half of them are women. If the rest of the teachers on the court are math teachers, and each teacher sleeps for 6 hours a day, calculate the total time the math teachers collectively spend sleeping in one day.

Candy has 15 light blue spools of thread, 45 dark blue spools of thread, 40 light green spools of thread, and 50 dark green spools of thread. Each spool of thread is 12 meters long. What percent of her spools are blue?

Aiden is making his famous steakhouse-seasoned meatballs for a neighborhood cookout. He adds two tablespoons of his secret steakhouse seasoning for every pound of ground beef he uses. He gets sixteen meatballs from each pound of meat. He needs to prepare a to-go box for every thirty meatballs. If he wants to make 80 meatballs for the cookout, how much of his secret seasoning will he need?
Tom plants 10 trees a year.  Every year he also chops down 2 trees a year.  He starts with 50 trees and 30 feet of wheat.  After 10 years 30% of the trees die.  How many trees does he have left?

Lani baked 55 cookies for a party. Before the party started, she ate 5 cookies to taste test them. Then, she decided to place the remaining cookies equally into five jars. Each jar already had 2 decorative pebbles in it. After placing the cookies, she removed the pebbles. How many cookies were in each jar after she removed the pebbles?

Brendan has a bag of marbles with 10 inside. Each marble is worth $3. He tripped over a pebble while carrying it and dropped half of them. He scrambled to search for them but only came up with 3. When he went back home, he inspected the marbles further. One of them he picked up wasn't a marble, but actually a bead so he got rid of it. How many marbles did Brendan end up with?

Apple High School is holding graduation in their Fine Arts Center this year which has space for 6000 people.  There will also 100 local media attending but not taking any seats. After accounting for 950 seats for graduates, 300 seats for faculty attending. how many tickets would each graduate receive to give to their friends and family if the tickets are split equally?

A mother goes shopping on a sunny day when the temperature is 75 degrees Fahrenheit. She buys cocoa at $4.20, laundry detergent at $9.45, and a package of pasta at $1.35. She also notices a beautiful dress priced at $50, but decides not to buy it. After paying with a $20 bill, how much change does the cashier give back?

A three-toed sloth, who is also a part-time magician, moves very slowly, and only eats when he is up in his tree. For a meal of berries, it takes the sloth 4 hours to make the trip down the tree, pick up berries, and climb back up into his tree. During his journey, he performs a magic trick that takes 30 minutes, but this does not affect his berry picking time. Assuming he picks the same number of berries on each trip and performs his magic trick without affecting his berry collection, what is the least number of berries he can pick up per trip down to the ground if he wants to collect 24 berries in 8 hours, while also performing his magic tricks?

Artie has a flower stand at the Farmers Market. He sells three kinds of flowers: marigolds, petunias, and begonias. He usually sells marigolds for $2.74 per pot, petunias for $1.87 per pot, and begonias for $2.12 per pot. Today, Artie has decided to offer sunflowers for $2.35 per pot. Artie has no change today, so he has decided to round all his prices to the nearest dollar. If Artie sells 12 pots of marigolds, 9 pots of petunias, and 17 pots of begonias, how much will he make?

You're shopping for a bag during a store-wide sale where all items are marked with a 5% discount. You also have a coupon for an additional 10% off, but it can't be combined with other discounts. If the bag you want is marked $140, how much will you pay after the 5% discount?

A company's HR hires 20 new employees every month to add to its total workforce. The company also has a policy of providing a $100 monthly transportation allowance to each employee, but this allowance is covered by a separate budget and does not affect the salary budget. If the company's initial employee number is 200, and each employee is paid a $4000 salary per month, calculate the total amount of money the company pays to its employees from the salary budget after three months?
On a 500-kilometer-long highway, Cho hiked 14 kilometers per hour for 8 hours. Chloe hiked 9 kilometers per hour and stopped after 5 hours. How many kilometers farther did Cho hike?

In a school, there are 29 pupils in a class and 15 pupils in another class. The teacher of the class with 29 pupils has 9 coupons, each coupon can be redeemed for 100 bottles of apple juice. The teacher of the other class has 5 coupons, but she decided not to redeem them. The teacher with the 9 coupons gives each student in her class 2 bottles of apple juice to drink for lunch, while the other teacher gives her students water. After redeeming all her coupons and giving each student their apple juice lunch, how many bottles of apple juice does the teacher of the class with 29 pupils have for herself?

There are 96 fourth-graders at Small Tree  School. 43 of them are girls. And there are 80 fifth-graders at Small Tree School. On Friday, 5 fourth-grade girls and 4 fourth-grade boys were absent. How many fourth-grade boys were at Small Tree  School on Friday?
Alice has 6 more books than Steven. Clara has two times as many books as Steven. If Clara has 20 books and each book costs $3, how many more books does Clara have than Alice?

Julia was preparing for a dinner party at her house, where she intended to serve stew and a dessert. She noticed that she was out of plastic spoons, so she bought a new package of spoons. Later, her husband also bought a package of 5 new spoons and gave them to Julia. While Julia was making the stew, she used three of the spoons to sample her stew. She also used two spoons to taste the dessert she was making, but she washed and returned them to the pile. Later, when she went to set the table, she had a total of 12 spoons. How many spoons were in the package that Julia bought?

The Hortex company produces bottled carrot juices. Every day it can produce 4200 bottles of these juices. It also can produce 2,000 carrot pies per day. Each juice can cover 20% of 1 person's daily energy demand. How many more bottles of juices would Hortex have to produce to be able to satisfy 100% of the daily energy needs of 2300 people?

Gretchen has 110 coins in her collection. Among these, there are 30 more gold coins than silver coins. She also has a separate collection of 50 bronze coins and 20 copper coins, which are not included in the 110 coins. How many gold coins does Gretchen have in her collection of 110 coins?

Ruiz can make 120 pounds of chocolates in two hours. Marissa makes 3/4 times as many pounds of chocolates in an hour as Ruiz makes in the two hours. There are 10 pieces of chocolate per pound. If they worked for 12 hours in a day, calculate the total amount of chocolate pounds they made together.
Andy plants 90 geraniums, 40 fewer petunias than geraniums, and 50 more trees than petunias. How many flowers does he plant in total?

Gene is sewing a quilt out of old souvenir t-shirts. He has one shirt from each vacation he has been on. Every shirt is its own quilt block. Each row is made of blocks from a different year of vacations. He goes on four vacations a year and has been vacationing since he was 23 years old. He is now 34. In addition, he has a collection of 50 hats from various sports events he attended, but he decided not to include them in the quilt. How many quilt blocks does he have in total, disregarding the hats?

Jaime is working in a bakery. He has 64 eggs and 2 trays to place them on. Each tray can hold 24 eggs. In the midst of his work, he receives a delivery of 10 additional trays and 120 more eggs, but he decides to set them aside for now. Given this, how many of the original 64 eggs won't he be able to place on his original 2 trays?

Tomorrow, Mia's restaurant is hosting a function where 42 adults, 15 babies, and 5 dogs will be attending. The dogs, being well-trained, will sit on the floor and don't need chairs. The restaurant has 5 times as many regular chairs as high chairs, and there are also 3 stools that are not suitable for the guests. If there are 8 high chairs, how many more chairs does Mia have to get for the function?

Toula went to the bakery and bought various types of pastries. She bought 3 dozen donuts which cost $68 per dozen, 2 dozen mini cupcakes which cost $80 per dozen, and 6 dozen mini cheesecakes for $55 per dozen. She also noticed that the bakery was selling a special holiday cookie for $5 each, but she decided not to buy any. How much was the total cost of the pastries she bought?
Erin has 7 lollipops and 5 white rabbit lollies. Her mother gives Erin another 10 lollipops. If Erin gives 3 of her lollipops to Ella, how many lollipops does she have left?

Russell orders his favorite bagels online.  Each pack of bagels costs $10.00 and has 9 bagels in the pack.  If he orders 4 packs of bagels, he will receive a 10% discount. He has a $2 coupon but finds it expired. After ordering 4 bags, how much will each single bagel cost?

Jay is making snowballs to prepare for a snowball fight with his sister. It takes his sister an hour and a half to build a snowman. He can build 20 snowballs in an hour, but 2 melt every 15 minutes. How long will it take before he has 60 snowballs?

Mark works at his job for 8 hours a day for 5 days a week. He used to make $10 an hour but they raised his pay by $2 per hour. Now, he also spends $20 on commuting to work each week, but his employer reimburses him for this expense. How much does he make a week?

A marketing company pays its employees on a commission-based salary system. If you sell goods worth $1000, you earn a 30% commission. Sales over $1000 get you an additional 10% commission. Calculate the amount of money Antonella earned if she sold goods worth $2500, including a $1,500 bag.

Theo has $6000 he wishes to spend on his upcoming business trip to South Africa. He buys 6 business suits at $100 each, 3 suitcases at $50 each, and a flight ticket that costs $700 more than 5 times as much as the cost of a business suit. He also decides to buy a camera for $300 to document his trip and a travel guide book for $20, but he later gets a refund for these two items. He wishes to save $2000 for this trip, how much does he have to spend on buying gifts for his business partners in South Africa?
Liam is 16 years old now and he has a 2-year-old brother. Two years ago, Liam’s age was twice the age of Vince. How old is Vince now?

A real estate agent has spent $5 on each newspaper ad and spent $75 on each television ad. He bought 50 newspaper ads and 15 television ads. In the same period, he also spent $200 on a billboard ad and $50 on online ads, but he got a refund for these two ads. How much did the real estate agent spend on buying all the newspaper and television ads?
A boy has 5 cards and each card has three anime characters on it. His brother has 3 fewer cards than he has. How many cards do they have together?

While working at the restaurant, each of the forty customers who came into the restaurant gave Rafaela a $20 tip. Julieta received 10% less money in tips than Rafaela. Rafi rewarded herself for her hard work by buying a $20 lipstick. How much money did Julieta and Rafaela receive as tips altogether?

If Raymond does half as much laundry as Sarah, and Sarah does 4 times as much laundry as David, calculate the difference in the amount of laundry Raymond and David do. Assume that Sarah also does 100 pounds of laundry for her neighbor and 300 pounds of laundry for herself, totaling 400 pounds of laundry.

Ted starts with $200 and decides to go shopping. He buys 3 books for 16 dollars each and 3 pencils for 6 dollars each. On his way, he sees a beautiful painting priced at $500, but he decides not to buy it. He also considers buying a $30 hat, but changes his mind at the last minute. How much did he spend in total on the books and pencils?

James hires a horse-drawn carriage from 5 PM to 9 PM.  He gets 1 hour free.  The first paid hour is $15 and each hour after that is twice the cost. He also has a $10 rental voucher but finds it expired. How much did he pay?

Elise has been selling her Dad's collection of 250 books for three years. Each book sells at 20$, and she sold twice as many books in the first year as she has sold in the current year. There are currently 50 unsold books, and her sales number this year is 45. In the second year, she also started selling her own collection of 100 books at 15$ each, but unfortunately, she didn't manage to sell any. What's the total amount of money she earned in the second year from selling her Dad's books?

Deandre caught 3 tuna last Monday, the first tuna he caught weighed 56 kilograms, the second tuna he caught weighed 46 kilograms, and the last tuna he caught weighed 26 kilograms. He also caught 10 crayfish, each weighing 0.5 pounds. If a kilogram of tuna costs $0.50, how much will he earn after selling all the tuna to the market?

Paige is a skilled baker who can bake 2 banana bread loaves every hour. Each loaf is then meticulously cut into 8 slices and individually wrapped for sale. Each slice is sold for 50 cents at a fundraiser. On a particular day, Paige started baking at 1:00 PM. In the middle of her baking marathon, her friend dropped by at 3:30 PM to chat, but Paige continued baking without interruption. She finally finished baking at 6:00 PM. If she sold all the slices she baked that day, how much did she raise in dollars for the fundraiser?

Soledad, an avid hiker, works in a windowless office but is planning a grand outdoor adventure for her vacation in June. She has set a goal to hike 9,300 miles within that month. She plans to hike twice a day, covering 125 miles each time. However, she also wants to spend some time bird watching and has allocated 2 hours each day for this activity, during which she will cover no distance. Considering her bird watching time, how many more miles per day must Soledad hike to complete her journey on time?

In a world where there are 27 unicorns left, one third of them have made their home in the Scottish Highlands. Among these Scottish unicorns, two thirds are female. Meanwhile, the remaining unicorns are scattered across various locations, such as the French Alps where 5 unicorns reside, and the Norwegian fjords where 4 unicorns are spotted. Despite the presence of unicorns in these locations, the number of female unicorns in the Scottish Highlands remains unaffected. How many female Scottish unicorns are there?
