Ali is a superstar counter. He has won 22 medals for counting super fast. His friend Izzy is also a really good counter and has 5 less medals than Ali. Together they have 10 times less medals than have been given out for counting. Each medal is worth fifty dollars. How many medals have been given out for counting?

Prince is a butcher who sells 15kg of meat every hour he works, and he works 10 hours a day. His friend Bill gives him a bull that weighs 750kg. On the same day, Prince also receives a gift of 50kg of vegetables from his neighbor, which he decides to give away to his customers for free. Considering only the meat from Bill's bull, how many days will it take Prince to sell all the meat?

In a small library, there are 50 books. Half of them are written in English, and 10% in German. Among these books, 5 of them have red covers and 15 of them have blue covers. The rest of the books have green covers. All books that are not written in English or German are written in Spanish. How many Spanish books are there in the library?

Debra is monitoring a beehive to see how many bees come and go in a day. She sees 30 bees leave the hive in the first 6 hours, and then she sees 1/2 that many bees return in the next 6 hours. During this time, she also notices a nearby bird feeder with 15 birds. She sees two times as many bees as she saw first leave the hive fly from the hive and leave in the next 6 hours. Then every bee that left before that hadn't already returned returns to the hive in the next 6 hours. How many bees did Debra see return to the hive in the last 6 hours of the day?

Mara was at a party where there were 10 different types of cakes. She added 3 slices of her favorite cake to a plate that already had 2 slices of another cake on it. Seeing the variety of cakes, she got hungrier and decided to triple the number of slices she currently has on her plate. After dancing to 4 songs, she ate 2 slices of cake. While she was distracted watching a magic show, her friend, who had already eaten 7 slices of cake, stole 5 slices off her plate. What number of cake slices remained on Mara's plate?

Nick is choosing between two jobs. Job A pays $15 an hour for 2000 hours a year, and is in a state with a 20% total tax rate. Job A provides with 1 computer for free. Job B pays $42,000 a year and is in a state that charges $6,000 in property tax and a 10% tax rate on net income after property tax. How much more money will Nick make at the job with a higher net pay rate, compared to the other job?

Gunther, the gorilla, had 48 bananas hidden under a fern branch.  When Gunther wasn't looking, Arnold, the chimpanzee, stole half of the bananas from the pile.  The next day, Gunther added another 25 bananas to his pile, but later that evening, Arnold stole another 12 of the bananas.  On the third day, Gunther added another 6 bananasand three apples to his pile and began counting bananas.  How many bananas did Gunther find were in the pile?

Lisa is part of a choir that has 52 members, 50% of which are boys and 50% of which are girls.  The choir decides to perform with just its female members.  On the day of the performance, however, half the people performing can't make it to the show because their bus breaks down.  The choir's 3 teachers, 2 of whom are women, then decide to sing with them. How many people sang in the performance?

Shannon makes herself iced coffee by brewing hot coffee and adding ice cubes. The best temperature for coffee is 75 degrees. Each ice cube cools the coffee by 13 degrees but makes the coffee 12 milliliters weaker. Any added liquid also weakens the coffee. How many milliliters weaker is Shannon’s iced coffee when it is cooled by 65 degrees and she adds 15 milliliters of cream?

If it takes 3 kangaroos traveling at the same speed a total of 18 hours to travel across a highway, and it takes 2 rabbits traveling at the same speed a total of 12 hours to travel across a highway, how many hours will it take four turtles, each traveling at half the speed of a kangaroo, to do so?

Carla is downloading a 200 GB file. Normally she can download 2 GB/minute, but 40% of the way through the download, her computer's battery level drops to 15%, causing her to plug it into a power source. At the same time, Windows forces a restart to install updates, which takes 20 minutes. During this time, her computer charges up to 35% but this doesn't affect the download speed. After the restart, Carla has to restart the download from the beginning. How long does it take to download the file?

During a shopping trip, you bought 6 pencils, each costing $0.50, and 8 erasers, each costing $0.25. You also picked up a notebook that was on sale for $2.00, but decided not to buy it and put it back on the shelf. If you handed over a $10 bill to pay for your purchases, how much change would you receive?

Jennifer went to the market and bought 12 oranges and 5 apples. She gave each of her three daughters 2 oranges and 1 apple each, and her only boy got 3 oranges and 2 apples. If she didn't eat any of the apples, how many oranges did she remain with?

Students in class 3B are collecting school points for behavior. If they get enough points in total, they can go on a trip. In the class, there are Adam, Martha, Betty, and Tom. Adam has collected 50 points, 20 of which are for actively answering questions in class. Betty was better than Adam and collected 30% more. Marta managed to collect 3 times more points than Tom, who had 30 points less than Betty. How many points is the class missing to go on the trip if the minimum threshold is 400 points?

Mark is a copy-editor who also moonlights as a part-time DJ. He edits an equal number of sentences each week for two different publishers, who each pay him a different rate per sentence. Publisher B pays Mark twice what Publisher A pays. In his DJ job, he earns $200 per gig, but this doesn't affect his earnings from editing. Mark edits a total number of 1000 sentences each week, and Publisher A pays him 5 cents per sentence. Despite his DJ earnings, how much does Mark make in a week from his editing work, in cents?

Rose bought five dozens of eggs for $2.40 a dozen. On her way home, she found a $10 bill on the ground, which she used to buy a lottery ticket. Unfortunately, she didn't win anything from the lottery. She then decided to sell the eggs for $1 for 3 eggs. How much will be Rose's profit from selling the eggs?

Mark's car breaks down during a road trip and he needs to get a new radiator. The cost for a new radiator at a regular auto parts store is $400. However, he finds a junk shop 20 miles off his route that sells it for 80% off. He decides to drive the extra miles to the junk shop and buys the radiator. On his way back, he stops at a gas station and fills up his tank, which costs him $30, but he uses a coupon and gets a $30 discount, making the gas free. He then hires a mechanic to install the radiator. The mechanic charges $50 an hour and it takes him 3 hours to finish the job. How much did Mark end up paying in total?

The ratio of men to women on a car is 2:1. The ratio of men to women on a bus is 5:9. If the total number of passengers on the bus is 84, and 20 women alight from the bus at the next stop, how many women have remained on the bus?

Argo has 200 toys. He decides to give some away. He gives 40 toys to Alyssa, who already had 10 toys. He gives 80 to Bonnie, who had no toys at all. He also gives 30 to Nicky, who had 5 toys. After giving away these toys, how many toys does Argo have now?

Suzanne sold 80 cookies for $1 each and 60 cupcakes for $4 each. She also sold 100 candies for $0 each, which were promotional items. She gave her two sisters $10 each for helping her and also gave her friend $0 for moral support. How much money does she have left from her earnings?
In a candy machine, there are 22 more than four times the number of pink gumballs as there are blue gumballs. If there are 12 blue gumballs,  each worth $2, how many pink ones are there?

John is a diligent worker who completes 30 cycles of work each day. Each cycle consists of 5 different tasks. Each task pays $1.20. However, John also spends $0.50 on a cup of coffee after every 10 cycles to keep himself energized, but his employer reimburses him for these coffee breaks. If John works a full 7 day week, how much does he make?

A new arcade opens up in town and Jack decides to play with his 3 friends. Jack can play a game with 1 quarter for 20 minutes. Two of his friends are significantly worse than him and can only play half as long. One of them is significantly better and can play for 1.5 times as long. They play for 4 hours. Meanwhile, a group of 5 other kids are playing a different game that costs 2 quarters for 30 minutes, but this doesn't affect Jack and his friends. How much money is used by Jack and his friends?

Jenna starts out with 8 sapphires. She trades 3 sapphires for two rubies. She also wanted to trade 2 sapphires for 1 diamond that is worth $500, but eventually decided against it. If sapphires are worth $800 and rubies are worth $1200, how much money are all her jewels worth?

On average, Joe throws 25 punches per minute. A boxing match lasts 5 rounds of 3 minutes each. In between each round, there is a 1-minute break where Joe drinks 200ml of water but doesn't throw any punches. How many punches did he throw during the fight?

Mario is planning a winter adventure and needs to buy snowshoes for his 6 sled dogs. Each dog has four legs, but Mario also has a pet parrot who doesn't need snowshoes. If each pair of snowshoes costs $12.00 and Mario's parrot's birdseed costs $5.00 a bag, which he doesn't need to buy right now, how much will it cost Mario to buy snowshoes for all of his dogs?

20% of 50 people think horse #2 will win the big race, and two-fifths of them are girls.  60% of the remaining people think horse #7 will win.  The rest of the people think horse #12 will win the big race.  How many people think that horse #12 will win?

Juan is considering expanding his bakery menu by adding croissants. He has found a recipe that requires 1/4 pound of butter to make 1 dozen croissants. He plans to start by making 4 dozen croissants a day for a week. However, he also wants to make a butter cake each day that requires 1/2 pound of butter, but he has a separate stock of butter for the cakes. How many pounds of butter will he need from his main stock to make the croissants for a week?

Larry is an animal enthusiast who also enjoys gardening. He has 3 cats and for each cat, he has a rose bush in his garden. He has 3 times as many dogs as he has cats. For every dog, he has a tulip plant, but he has 2 fewer rabbits than dogs. Each rabbit has a corresponding sunflower in his garden. He has a fish tank with three times the number of fish as rabbits. For each fish, he has a daisy in his garden. He also has a collection of gerbils that's 1/3 the number of fish he has. For every gerbil, he has a lily in his garden. Despite the number of plants in his garden, how many pets does Larry have?

Two cups of flour are needed to make a dozen cookies. Carla is making 36 cookies today and 30 cookies tomorrow. She also plans to make a cake that requires 4 cups of flour, but her friend has agreed to provide the flour for the cake. How many cups of flour will Carla need to bake the cookies today and tomorrow?

Jamal's phone can hold 6 times more photographs than Brittany's phone.  The maximum number of photographs that Brittany's phone can hold is 50 times more than the number of birds in Jamal's photograph of the ducks at the zoo. The number of birds in Brittany's photograph of the ducks at the zoo is 100. If Jamal's phone can hold 1800 photographs, how many ducks can be seen in Jamal's photograph of ducks at the zoo?

John goes to a store to buy some items. He buys milk for 2 dollars and eggs for 3 dollars. He also picks up light bulbs for 3 dollars, cups for 3 dollars, and roach traps for 4 dollars. The store has a special offer where customers get a 5% discount on all items, but this discount is not applicable to John as he is not a member of the store's loyalty program. Additionally, there is a 10% tax on all nonfood items. How much did John spend in total?

In a park, there are 50 porcupines and 100 squirrels. The number of female porcupines is 3/5 of the total porcupine population, while the number of female squirrels is half of the total squirrel population. Each female porcupine gives birth to 4 babies every month, and each female squirrel gives birth to 2 babies every month. However, the park's capacity only allows for the growth of the porcupine population. How many porcupines will be in the park after a year, considering only the porcupine population growth?

The rug in the living room is 5 feet wider than the chair, and there's a coffee table that is 7 feet long placed between them. The couch is 2 feet longer than twice the width of the rug. If the chair, which is placed 4 feet away from the coffee table, is 3 feet wide, how many feet long is the couch?

In the bustling city of Soda, there are exactly 23786 inhabitants. Among them, 8417 are men and 9092 are women. The city also has 1000 dogs, 500 cats, and 200 birds, but these are not included in the human population count. The rest of the human population is made up of children. How many children are there in Soda?

Jo has been making face masks. She can make 4 small masks with 2 yards of material and 3 large masks with 2.25 yards of material. It takes 15 minutes to make a large mask. How much material would she need to make 20 small and 8 large masks for her class?

Tim spends 6 hours each day at work answering phones.  It takes him 15 minutes to deal with a call. After work, he would enjoy 2-hour movive at home.  How many calls does he deal with during his 5 day work week?
Jean has 30 lollipops, each worth $0.50. Jean eats 2 of the lollipops. With the remaining lollipops, Jean wants to package 2 lollipops in one bag. How many bags can Jean fill?

Monica is wrapping Christmas gifts while listening to her favorite holiday music. She has 6 gifts to wrap for her family, 4 gifts to wrap for her friends, and 2 gifts to wrap for her teachers. She also has 3 gifts for her neighbors, but she has already wrapped those with a different ribbon. Now, she has 144 inches of ribbon left and wants to make a bow for each of the unwrapped gifts with it. If she wants to use the same length of ribbon for each gift bow, how many inches of ribbon can she use for each gift bow?

Norman High School enrolls an average of 4000 students every year, half of whom are girls. Butler High School, the neighboring school, enrolls an average of 3/4 as many students as Norman High School. How much greater is the average enrollment at Norman High School than the enrollment at Butler High School?

Doxa sliced an apple into 8 pieces. Each piece of apple has about 10 calories. She ate 1 slice, her sister ate 1 more than her, and her brother ate 1 more than her sister. How many slices of apple did they all eat?

Robert had 3 pounds of candy, Cindy had 5 pounds of candy, and Aaron had 4 pounds of candy and 2 halloween toys after Halloween. If they decide to pool and share their candy equally with each other, how much candy would each of them have?

A bumper car rink has 12 red cars. They have 2 fewer green cars than they have red cars. They have 3 times the number of blue cars as they have green cars. The rink also has yellow cars.  If the rink has 75 cars in total, and each can seat 2 people, how many yellow cars do they have?

Each person in a certain household consumes 0.2 kg of rice and 0.1 kg of vegetables every meal. Supposing 5 members of the household eat rice every lunch and dinner, how many weeks will a 42 kg bag of rice last?

Walter is collecting money for a charity event. Initially, he collects $500 from his neighbors. On the same day, he finds a $20 bill on the street, but he decides to use it to buy supplies for the event instead of adding it to the charity fund. Then, he collects $1500 from a fund he set up online.Meanwhile, his friend, who just got a raise of $1000, gives him $200 as well. His lawyer, who just won a case and received a bonus of $5000, offers to donate three times as much as everyone else donates. How much is Walter's lawyer going to contribute?

Mike decides he wants to replace his movie collection with digital versions. He has 600 movies. A third of the movies are in various series and he knows he can get those for only $6 of the cost of a normal movie by just buying the series together. 40% of the remaining movies are older movies which are $5. He also has a collection of 200 music albums, but he decides not to replace them digitally. How much does replacing the movies cost if a normal movie costs $10, and a music album costs $8, which he is not considering in his budget?

Jim is making a comforter for his king-sized bed. He needs two pieces of fabric that are 2 feet longer and 2 feet wider than the bed, which measures 6 feet long by 8 feet wide. He has made a small quilt for his dog, two feet long and one foot wide, from the fabric he already had. How many square feet of fabric does Jim need to buy?

Jonathan has 2/3 as many measuring spoons as measuring cups. If he has two dozen cups, four dozen forks and gifts Pedro 6 measuring spoons for his birthday, calculate the total number of utensils Jonathan has remaining.
Amber, Micah, and Ahito ran 52 miles in total. Mike ran 6 miles. Amber ran 8 miles. Micah ran 3.5 times what Amber ran. How many miles did Ahito run?

Matt is planning a snack, but his dad wants him to maintain a balanced diet. His dad tells him that for every two carrot sticks he eats, he can have one cookie. Additionally, he can have two extra cookies if he cleans his room. If Matt's room is already clean and he wants to eat five cookies in total, how many carrot sticks does he have to eat? Also, consider that Matt's dad has a bowl of 20 carrot sticks and a jar of 10 cookies, but remember, Matt only wants five cookies.

Nancy is returning her overdue books to the library and intends to borrow 6 more books. She owes 0.50 cents each on 8 books, plus a flat $2.00 fee for having at least one book that's over a week overdue. How much does she have to pay in total?

Steve decides to start eating more tomatoes and decides to grow his own cherry tomatoes.  He eats twice as much as his girlfriend.  He eats 6 per day. In addition, he eats 20 cherries a day.  If a vine can produce 3 tomatoes per week how many vines does he need?

Aleksandra went to a restaurant for dinner during a special promotion. She ordered some soup, a bagel, and a piece of cake. The bagel cost $4, and the soup was priced 25% more. The cake was only half of the price of the bagel. The restaurant was offering a 100% discount on the most expensive item, but Aleksandra decided not to use it. Additionally, she was given a coupon for a free drink worth $3, but she chose not to redeem it. How much did Aleksandra need to pay for the dinner she ordered?

Hannah is training for a marathon and needs to drink 60 ml of water for each kilometer she runs. Her gym teacher, who is also her marathon coach, tells her to run 8 laps around the school's track. Each lap is 0.25 km. However, the coach also tells her that for every 5 laps she runs, she should take a 5-minute break to stretch and rest, during which she doesn't need to drink any water. If Hannah follows her coach's instructions, how many milliliters of water will she need to drink during her training session?

Solomon bought 20 marbles from his friend Johanna and added them to a store that had 50. On his way home, he found a bag with 30 marbles but decided to leave it as he had enough. If his father also gave him 2/5 times as many marbles as he bought from Johanna, and each marble weighs 2kgs, calculate the total weight of marbles Solomon has in the store, ignoring the marbles he found on his way home.

Alfie, the albatross, flies 400 kilometers every day. He starts his journey at 6 am every day and ends at 6 pm, taking a 2-hour break in between for rest and food. If the circumference of the earth is 40,000 kilometers and Alfie's average speed remains constant throughout his flight, how many days will it take Alfie to fly a distance equal to half of the way around the earth?

Charlie wants to sell beeswax candles.  For every pound of beeswax, he can make 10 tapered candles, which takes two hours.  One pound of beeswax and the wicks cost $10.00 in supplies.   If he sells each candle for $2.00 each, what is his net profit if he makes and sells 20 candles?

The price of Parmesan cheese is $11 per pound. Mozzarella cheese is $6 per pound. Amor buys 2 pounds of Parmesan and 3 pounds of mozzarella cheese. She also considers buying a bottle of olive oil for $10 and a loaf of bread for $3, but decides not to. If she starts with $50 cash, how much money, in dollars, will she have left to buy meat?

James delivers 600 newspapers in a day, 200 of which are English-language newspapers. He delivers 198 newspapers to District A, some to District B, and 209 newspapers to District C. How many newspapers does he deliver to District B?

Bailey starts with a certain amount of money. Then she receives a weekly allowance of $5 for 8 weeks. One day, while shopping, she sets her eyes on a $200 dress but does not buy it because it is too expensive. At the end of the 8 weeks, if she has a total of $100, how much money did Bailey start with?

Shawnda decides that her neighborhood kids could really use a bike inflation service. She decides the best way to charge is by the tire. Each tire costs 25 cents to inflate. On the first day, 5 people on bicycles came by to get both tires inflated. 3 people came by to get all their tricycle tires inflated. Finally, one person actually came by on a unicycle. In the midst of all this, a local news station decided to cover her story and gave her a $10 tip, which she decided to donate to a local charity. Also, a passerby gave her a $5 coupon for a local ice cream shop, which she decided to use later. How many dollars did she make from inflating tires that day?

Brook Hills High School currently enrolls 3000 students. Half of these students are over 16 years old, and one-fourth of the students over 16 years old are male. The remaining half of the students are under 16 years old, and one-half of the students under 16 are male. In addition, girls with long hair make up one third of the total number of girls In total, how many female students are enrolled at this school?

Josh decides to take up juggling to perform at the school talent show a month in the future. He starts off practicing juggling 3 balls, and slowly gets better adding 1 ball to his juggling act each week. After the end of the fourth week, the talent show begins. On the day of the show, Josh's friend gives him a lucky charm, a small coin, to keep in his pocket. The coin weighs 10 grams, but this doesn't affect Josh's performance. When Josh walks on stage, he slips and drops three of his balls. 2 of them are caught by people in the crowd as they roll off the stage, but one gets lost completely since the auditorium is dark. Despite the weight of the coin in his pocket, Josh starts to juggle on stage with how many balls?
Justin has a jar with many coins in it. He also has a box containing 20 $5 bills. The jar has 32 quarters, 95 dimes, 120 nickels, and 750 pennies. What is the total dollar amount in the jar?

Morisette and Kael were asked to bring fruits for a picnic. Morisette brought 5 apples and 8 oranges, while Kael brought twice the amount of apples and half the number of oranges than Morisette. In the meantime, their friend, Lila, decided to bring 10 bananas and 15 grapes, but unfortunately, she tripped and all her fruits fell into a river. How many fruits do Morisette and Kael have in total for the picnic?

Two cars are driving on a highway, which is 800 miles long.  The first car is traveling at an average speed of 60 miles per hour when the second car passes it at an average speed of 70 miles per hour.  If both cars continue on the highway at the same speed, how many miles will separate them after 2 hours?

Miss Maria is a middle school teacher, and she loves to collect sports cards. She has six decks with 25 basketball cards in each deck and five boxes with 40 baseball cards in each box. Miss Maria is going to give her sister Jane 10 cards, but Jane refuses. She keeps 50 cards and gives the remaining cards to her students. If her students got ten cards each, how many students does Miss Maria have?

Emily has 4 kids named Amy, Jackson, Corey, and James, and she has a 3-year-old dog. Amy is 5 years older than Jackson and 2 years younger than Corey. If James is 10 and is 1 year younger than Corey, how old is Jackson?

While playing with her friends in their school playground, Katelyn saw 50 fairies flying above the nearby forest. At the same time, she noticed a group of 20 butterflies fluttering around the playground, but they soon flew away. After about twenty minutes, one of her friends saw half as many fairies as Katelyn saw come from the east and join the fairies that were there. Meanwhile, a flock of 15 birds flew over the playground, but they didn't interact with the fairies. Ten minutes later, 30 fairies, along with 10 dragonflies that were buzzing around, flew away. Ignoring the butterflies, birds, and dragonflies, how many fairies are remaining?

Ten stalls have 20 cows each, and 2 stalls have 15 chickens each. Mr. Sylas buys 40 cows and divides them equally, putting an equal number of the new cows into each of the twenty stalls. How many cows are in 8 of the stalls?
Together, Sofie, Anne, and Fawn have 85 books, and each book costs $5. If Sofie has 25 more books than Anne, and Anne has 12 fewer books than Fawn does, how many books does Fawn have?

Jess is at a carnival, trying to guess the number of blue jellybeans in a jar to win a prize. She notices that there are 17 green jelly beans and twice as many red jelly beans. She also sees a separate jar with 30 yellow jellybeans, but this jar is not part of the guessing game. In the jar she's guessing, there are a total of 60 jelly beans. How many of the jellybeans in the jar she's guessing are blue?

Three friends decided to go to the fair. They bought 3 tickets for $20.25 and spent $4.50 less on food than they did on the tickets. They also decided to try out a game booth that cost $5 each, but they won a coupon that allowed them to play for free. After that, they went on 2 different rides which cost $33 each. Despite the distraction of the game booth, they agreed to split all the costs evenly. How much did each of them pay?

Brett is 14 years old and he has a pet turtle that is 5 years old. In four years, when Brett's turtle will be 9 years old, his sister Angela will be three times as old as Brett is now. Despite the age of the turtle, how old is Angela right now?

Brinley is in Mr. Bert's math class. Mr. Bert gives six tests each semester. He allows the students to remove the lowest score from the average each semester. Brinley also participates in a weekly math quiz, but these scores do not affect her test average. If Brinley has scores of 89, 71, 92, 100 and 86 on the first five tests, and her quiz scores for the semester are 78, 85, 90, 88, 92, 94, 96, 98, 100, 95, 97, 99, 100, 98, 96, 94, 92, 90, 88, 86, 84, 82, 80, 78, 76, what score does she need on the sixth test to get an average of 93 for her tests?

At Allan's house, there is twice as much corn as cannolis, and there is thrice as much soybean as cannolis. He has a total of 40 cannolis in his house. Allan bought 60 more cannolis at the store and 40 fewer corns than the number of cannolis. Find the combined total of the number of corns and cannolis Allan has in the house?

Andrew is a passionate baker who decides to bake 200 mini cinnamon rolls and 300 mini blueberry muffins for a local charity event. He also bakes 50 chocolate chip cookies, but they are not for the event. A normal cinnamon roll has 600 calories, a normal blueberry muffin has 450 calories, and a chocolate chip cookie has 200 calories. If a mini pastry has 1/3rd of the calories of a normal version, and the cookies are not counted in the total, how many calories do the pastries he baked for the event have?

In a marine biology lab, there are two aquariums. One aquarium houses 4 snails and 5 starfish, while the other aquarium contains 32 snails and 7 sea urchins. The difference between the number of snails in the two aquariums is twice the total number of fish in both aquariums. If both aquariums have the same number of fish in them, how many fish are there in each aquarium?
